scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Two-level time-independent Hermitian Hamiltonians, rank-one projective detection of either the preparation state or its orthogonal complement at Poisson interrogation times.
limitations: No claim for non-Poisson interrogation or higher-dimensional spaces.
Above-threshold survival crossing is guaranteed for sufficiently small rates, not every rate.
The renewal transforms and mean detection times are pre-existing results; the assessed contribution is a sharp stochastic-order classification.
Reproducibility tests are finite; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_integrity.verification: Analytic convolution and sinc-extremum argument; independent deterministic checker for exact transforms and representative parameters.

title: A sharp coherence-visibility boundary for quantum first-detection stochastic order
